title: Iterated tests and frequency packet regularity
source_hypothesis: Fixed 1/2<rho<=1; counterexample restricted to rho<1. Every finite proper S_{rho,1-rho}^{2rho-1} word with full principal restriction in S_rho^0. Endpoint is exactly fixed B^(-m-n/4)_{2,infinity}. Corrected criterion uses all Q-normal derivatives on R^rho frequency cells, adapted coordinates and wavefront containment.
completed_component_scope: Full vanishing-test phase-class invariance and both cutoff families; compact all-admissible-word counterexample with sharp order gap; exact frequency-cell characterization and intrinsic microlocal equivalence.
source_qualification: Fixed-endpoint converse under these definitions is disproved; no official erratum claimed. Ordinary rho=1 characterization and phase-defined general-rho class retained.
reviewed_arguments: The exact endpoint and test class are stated before any claim: fixed B^(-m-n/4)_{2,infinity}, every finite word, S_{rho,1-rho}^{2rho-1}, and restriction of a full representative to S_rho^0. Ordinary and general-rho statements remain distinct.

Taylor division gives coefficient order rho and exact frequency integration by parts preserves the phase-defined I_rho^m. Proper localization, all mixed derivatives and ordered matrices are retained. Every word has the required fixed endpoint; elliptic positive-order tests give wavefront containment.
Both printed scaled cutoff families have every S_rho^{2rho-1} estimate, exact graph pullback and vanishing restriction. Their role does not prove an unjustified reverse implication.

The exact unitary modulation/dilation yields the scaled full left symbol. Taylor division separates the order-zero graph value. Both r_xi>=R/2 and r_xi<R/2 regimes have polynomial frequency growth and at most linear base growth, uniformly in R.

Derivative terms where the linear base factor is differentiated use b=|beta|-1; the other terms use b=|beta|. The exact R power is nonpositive in both cases. Frequency integration by parts proves uniform Schwartz continuity with finite input seminorms.

A proper localized operator differs by a smooth compact kernel whose exact scaling includes R^(-rho*n). Modulation supplies R^(-delta*J) after integration by parts. Fixed output weights and all derivatives are controlled. This proves uniform packet-family action for every fixed finite admissible word.

The lacunary Fourier series defines a tempered distribution, and compact base multiplication gives a genuine compactly supported distribution. Fourier packet supports are disjoint before that multiplication and its singular support is only zero.

After every admissible word, the packet Fourier profiles stay uniformly Schwartz. Both low-center and high-center geometric tails, finite comparable terms and the low-frequency block are estimated explicitly. No output orthogonality is assumed.

The compact localization preserves its own peak, and both cross-packet tails are negligible there. The exact positive peak excludes S_rho^{m-n/4}; differentiated tail bounds prove sharp actual order m+(1-rho)*n/2 and exclude every smaller order.

The proper real phase regularization supplies commuting Q operators and their exact Fourier gauge. Frequency cells of radius R^rho and the precise volume exponent give both directions of the replacement criterion with no order loss.

Uniform fixed-ball Sobolev control recovers each symbol derivative from finitely many cell estimates. Microlocal elliptic reconstruction, wavefront containment and finite phase assembly prove full intrinsic equivalence and independence of charts, frames, cutoffs, regularization and cell margins.

The ordinary rho=1 theorem is retained. The fixed-endpoint converse is marked disproved rather than proved; the cell criterion is separately marked proved and the source qualification resolved. The phase definition and all previous valid calculus are retained.

Three complete solutions give exact packet orders and norm powers, the scaled uncut test calculation with the distinction from admissible cutoff tests, and finite-derivative cell recovery. Thirty-three finite checks verify only exact scale, gauge and algebraic identities.

All 353 formulas and 34 displays parse. Thirteen overlapping desktop captures, the complete original Fourier-profile/order-gap figure and two mobile samples were inspected. Crowded figure ticks were corrected and re-inspected; all horizontal extents are accessible.

The exact approved IV4 and IV16 formulas were visually inspected, and III96–102 was read to confirm the Besov notation. Two exact owned source previews were deleted after inspection, reclaiming 399697 bytes. Original PDFs and page-text/preview hashes remain. No workers, backups or messages to other sessions were used.
